answer: Re-attestations are stored in tide and dawn lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the reef graph. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 20 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 277 impostors cost 1325 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
